question: What should be placed again on all hand fingers?
premises: karāṅguliṣu sarveṣu locates all hand fingers
prāsādaṃ vinyaset punaḥ prescribes placing prāsāda again
inference: The prāsāda mantra should be placed again on all hand fingers.
plain_english: Place the prāsāda mantra again on all hand fingers.
